name: tinto-add-winery-record
description: Entering an already-agreed client or affiliation's record and branding (logo, brand accent color) into Airtable's Client / Affiliation table, sourced by web search rather than a chat upload, validated against what the booking-page generator actually needs (clean name, transparent-background landscape logo, valid hex accent color), plus an explicit wine-club discount interview step. Split out of tinto-guest-communication so it can be installed on its own, for anyone who needs this without the rest of Nélia's daily guest-communication scope.
